name: Basotho Hat (Mokorotlo) building
subtitle: A building in central Maseru designed in the shape of the traditional Basotho conical hat.

facts.label: Hat origin tradition
facts.value: Hat shape said to be copied from Mount Qiloane next to Thaba Bosiu

parts.text: A building in central Maseru designed in the shape of the traditional Basotho conical hat. Described by a tourism site as housing a museum on the nation's history, culture and traditions.
